abilitygroupdescription.p: Arcana magic represents magical abilities and learning that is common to many other schools of magic. It is comprised of simple, fairly generic, magic source agnostic spells. Arcana involves the use of the characters magic pool and is only available to certain archetypes.

abilitycheck.name: Cast
abilitycheck.critsuccess: 4 shifts up for missile defence checks
abilitycheck.righteoussuccess: 3 shifts up for missile defence checks
abilitycheck.success: 2 shifts up for missile defence checks

abilitydescription.p: The aegis spell is perhaps optimistically named. It briefly forms an invisible force umbrella about in diameter that protects the character from rain, winds, and potentially gaseous attacks. Can be cast to cushion the impact from falling, reducing damage by 1d6. Anyone within the spells radius gains two shifts up when defending against missile attacks. It can also aditionally protect one adjacent medium or small creature.

The caster designates a volume of space no larger than a typical room. Movement within that region results in the caster receiving a short sharp shock of thaumaturgical energy, notifying them of that movement and waking them if they are asleep.
Once cast the character may move away from the area provided they maintain a contagious link with the area
This is the entry rank for all magic. It represents a basic understanding of the principles of magic. The character has read extensively of magic history and theory.

The character creates a cloak of darkness around themselves. This makes it very difficult to see the character in low light environments. If successfully cast this spell grants a bonus of +3xRank to Sneak Checks in dark or dimly lit places.

Ignis allows the caster to create fire of torch intensity by heating the air. If cast on a creature, that creature suffers d4 fire damage. At rank 1 this spell requires physical contact with the target to cast. At rank 2 and higher it has a range of a five meters.
Allows the user to make a weapon flame for the duration of a combat. Flaming weapons do +d6 extra fire damage. The flame is magical and will not burn wooden weapons.
In the event of overcharge the caster suffers 2d6 fire damage.

abilitycheck.name: Cast
abilitycheck.critfail: Gains the "You don't know the Horrors I've Seen" aspect.

abilitydescription.p: The character is able to discern the true nature of a being, seeing past glamours or other illusiary effects. This does not allow the character to discern motive or the content of a persons character.
Care should be taken because some creatures true form may be so hideous that it effects the observers sanity.
The character knows how to write magical scrolls for spells that they know, given sufficent time, and writing materials.
